description:
Add Beadwork goal record and reject supervisor config, without deleting WorkerRuntime types yet (orchestrator.ts still exists until delete-runtime).

## Background

`/bw run` currently stores SessionRunOptions (workers, until, noSpawn, dryRun, maxCycles) and enters a polling supervisor. We replace that with a small Goal: `{ goalId, scopeIds (exactly one epic), reviewPolicy, startedAt }` and session mode `run` meaning "goal appendix + injected prompt", not a loop.

Config today has tmux, worktrees, landing, supervisor, workerExecution. Loader must report **all** removed-key errors together and refuse to start **goal mode** on leftovers. Keep type fields so the still-present orchestrator compiles until delete-runtime. Do not silently ignore removed keys.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/types.ts` (add Goal; keep old worker types until delete-runtime)
- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/config.ts`
- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/session-state.ts`
- config tests

## Behavior

- Persisted `mode: "run"` after /new or process death is **interrupted**: do not auto-inject a prompt, do not recreate children. User must `/bw run` again. Drop trackedWorkerIds/runOptions as supervisor residue (stop persisting them; ignore on load).
- Review policy: ticket | scope | none. Default ticket.
- Reject PI_BEADWORK_* env vars that map to removed keys (tmux, worktree, poll, workers, etc.).
- Do not migrate landing.validateCommands into a new beadwork gate.

## Success criteria

- Loading config with tmux.sessionName fails goal-mode start with an actionable error.
- Clean config loads; Goal can be written and rehydrated; rehydrated run does not imply live workers.
- WorkerRuntime types still exist so orchestrator.ts typechecks until the delete issue.

## Test plan

- Unit: migration error aggregation.
- Unit: session JSON without runOptions.
- Unit: interrupted run does not look live.

## Considerations

This issue owns types.ts/config.ts/session-state.ts. Do not rewrite prompt.ts or actions/run.ts here.
title: Add goal record, interrupted run, and reject supervisor config
